_note: P0 content (M1 homestead + M2 fish/cook/eat) (gameplay plan v2: §3.1.1 energy, §3.3.2 costs, §4.2.1 level-difference, §4.5 thresholds, §5.2.2 crops, §5.3 planting rules, §5.4.1 farming XP, §9.11.1 stall, §9.13.1 buyback, §14.1.2 start kit; M2: §6.1.2–6.1.3 fishing gates and protection, §6.2.2 fish, §6.3.1 pond weights, §6.4 rod/bait, §6.6.1 cast energy, §6.7.1 fishing XP, §7.2.3–7.2.5 cooking, §7.3 ingredient families, §7.4.1 rarity derivation, §7.6.2 cooking XP, §7.14 recipes, §7.17.1 eating). Shared by server/src/p0 and the Godot client (labels only). M2b: P0 fish list (§17.2.1) — Willow Pond (Pond template) and Willow Creek (River template) on the homestead; mackerel is Coast-only (shown in the Fish-dex, not catchable here). Recipes: the 14 pages that need only P0 fish and crops; rock-salt pages (#11, #16, #29, #37) wait for materials. M3a (SGODOT-228): Homestead Lv1–3 (§8.1–8.3), farm storage (§10.4.8), materials and their buyback (§9.13.1, sources come with SGODOT-162/163), Bag Upgrade I, drinks (§3.4.4, §9.12), counters by role and buyback quotas (§9.11, §9.13.1), compost (§9.11.1, §17.2.1), Row Hoe and the Shanghai Postcard (§9.11.2, §9.11.5), residents Pip and Old Kai with affinity, gifts and gift meals (§3.4.5, §9.4.3–9.4.4, §7.6.3), and the Stall / Market boards (§9.6, §9.13.2). Numbers and copy per Li Bai on SGODOT-228 (b7d8b665, v1.1, 719ce953). Outpost names and keepers live in p0_outposts.json. q(40): Wild Herb is a material and a seasoning like Herb; the Fishing Lv2 gift gives Wild Herb ×3. q(41): Rest needs 2 h since the player last left the homestead (rest_away_h). S1 (SGODOT-232): first cast and first landed fish 10 / 10, first catch in a city +10 (q(37), the city comes from the server's fishing site); the Cooking Lv2 gift is the Fresh Fish Soup recipe (§4.6.3). S6 (SGODOT-232): fishing.sites are the Pond / River templates; fishing.places map each catalog pond to its template by point, not shape (q(36): Shanghai Reed Pond is the beginner pond, Reed / Willow / Fern = Pond, Pebble / Blossom / Clover = River); skill_daily_cap is the per-skill anti-script limit (§4.3.4). S5 (SGODOT-232): cooking.recipes are the 14 P0 pages of §7.14.0 (q(39)) with their Cookbook page number n, style and how they can be learned; cooking.pages are the other 34 pages as silhouettes (rarity, the family of each slot), not cookable in P0.

postcard_shanghai.name: Shanghai Postcard
postcard_shanghai._kept: No longer sold (SGODOT-270, q(106): P0 moved to San Francisco); kept so a save that bought one still names it.

affinity._p1: P1 (SGODOT-284, 苏烈 draft for 李白 to edit): lesson = §7.5.3 Taught, one page a week from Familiar out of the resident's teaches list (pages the player has not got yet); next_request_h = §9.6.1, a resident without one_per_day opens the next request 24 h after the last. Pip and Old Kai keep one_per_day (the next player day, q(33)).

lines.Stranger: Hi! I'm Pip. I carry letters all over San Francisco.
lines.Familiar: I saved you something. Don't tell the others.
lines.mystery: Um… thanks? I'll save it for later.
lines.Trusted: You're on my route now. Every day!
lines.Kindred: Best friend on the whole route. Don't tell the pigeons.

requests.title: Pip's First Fish
requests.text: Could you catch me a fish? Any kind is fine.

requests.title: Five Little Plots
requests.text: Plant five plots for me? I want to watch them grow.

requests.title: Lunch for Pip
requests.text: I'm starving. Any dish will do!

requests.title: Sweet Delivery
requests.text: Can you bake me something sweet? I'll run it across town!

requests.title: Pip's Big Route
requests.text: Ten letters, ten towns. I need fuel. Two sweets, please?

lines.Familiar: Sit. I grilled too much again.
lines.Trusted: You read the water well now.
lines.Kindred: Take the good stool. You've earned it.

requests.title: An Old Man's Catch
requests.text: Bring me a Rare fish. Haven't seen one in weeks.

requests.title: Dusk Supper
requests.text: Grill me something. Fish, of course.

requests.title: The Smoker's Secret
requests.text: Smoked trout, the old way. Bring me one and I'll tell you a secret.

lines.Stranger: Sit by the fire, dear. Warm your hands.
lines.Acquainted: Even a failed dish teaches you something.
lines.Familiar: I made too much again. Take some.
lines.Trusted: You remind me of my grandson. He never sat still either.
lines.Kindred: This fire will always be here for you.

requests.title: Kindling
requests.text: Bring me some wood for the fire, would you?

requests.title: Something Warm
requests.text: A bowl of soup would warm these old bones.

requests.title: Grandma's Garden
requests.text: Plant a few plots for me. I like to watch things grow.

requests.title: The Old Recipe
requests.text: Bring me three soups and I'll write down my mother's recipe.

lines.Stranger: New in town? So am I. I'm always new in town.
lines.Acquainted: I've seen markets you wouldn't believe.
lines.Familiar: Here, from the road. Don't ask where.
lines.Trusted: Long trips need the right papers. I'll show you how.
lines.Kindred: Wherever you go, I've probably been. Ask me anything.

requests.title: Road Snack
requests.text: Anything to eat on the road? I leave tomorrow.

requests.title: Rare Goods
requests.text: A Rare fish sells well three towns over. Find me one?

requests.title: Trader's Feast
requests.text: A Rare dish. I want to see what you can really do.

lines.Acquainted: Neighbour towns are cheaper by the river road, you know.
lines.Familiar: Sing with me! No? Then eat with me.
lines.Trusted: The river tells stories, if you listen.
lines.Kindred: Any time you need a crossing, my friend.
lines.mystery: Ha! Brave cooking. The fish would be proud.

requests.title: River Catch
requests.text: Bring me two fish. Any kind, river or pond.

requests.title: Fine Waters
requests.text: The good river fish, a Fine one. Can you?

requests.title: Ferryman's Stew
requests.text: A good soup for a long crossing.

requests.title: The Long Crossing
requests.text: Three Fine fish for the boat. I pay the river toll.

lines.Stranger: Mind your head. Low ceilings down there.
lines.Acquainted: Copper runs in the second floor. Look for the green.
lines.Trusted: Forty years down there. You're the first I'd take along.
lines.Kindred: The mine's yours as much as mine now.
lines.mystery: Hrm. Tastes like the bottom of a cart.

requests.title: Stone Count
requests.text: Eight stones for the shaft wall. Don't dawdle.

requests.title: Copper Run
requests.text: Copper ore. Four pieces.

requests.title: Rock Salt
requests.text: Rock salt for the grill. Three.

requests.title: Miner's Lunch
requests.text: A grilled dish. Fine or better. I have standards.

lines.Stranger: Welcome in! Grab a seat anywhere.
lines.Acquainted: You look like you need a proper meal.
lines.Familiar: Veggie plate, on the house. Eat!
lines.Trusted: Weekend cooking at the tea table. You should come.

requests.title: Fresh for the Café
requests.text: Two fresh crops for the menu, please.

requests.title: A Proper Plate
requests.text: A Fine dish for the regulars.

requests.title: Tea Time
requests.text: A pot of fruit tea for the afternoon crowd.

requests.title: The Café's Special
requests.text: Two Fine dishes. I want a new special.

lines.Stranger: Trains run on time. So should you.
lines.Acquainted: Permits and tickets: the materials are all out there.
lines.Trusted: I'll stamp anything you bring me. Almost.
lines.mystery: This is… not on the timetable.

requests.title: Station Master's Lunch
requests.text: A grilled dish, please. On time.

requests.title: Timber for the Platform
requests.text: Ten wood for the platform. By evening.

requests.title: Bento Run
requests.text: Two grilled dishes for the night shift.

lines.Stranger: The light's on. Come in from the wind.
lines.Acquainted: Fish bite better after rain. Watch the sky.
lines.Familiar: Tea's warm. Sit with me a while.
lines.Trusted: Some nights you can see the big ones' shadows.
lines.Kindred: The stars look better with company.
lines.mystery: Hm. The gulls might like it.

requests.title: Night Catch
requests.text: Two fish for the lamp-room supper.

requests.title: A Pot of Tea
requests.text: Something to drink on a long watch.

requests.title: Fine Sight
requests.text: A Fine fish. I like to sketch them.

requests.title: Shadow in the Water
requests.text: Something Rare is down there. Bring it to me.

lines.Stranger: Oh! A visitor. Please, look around.
lines.Acquainted: Every stamp tells where someone has been.
lines.Familiar: I catalogued your last gift. It was delicious.
lines.Trusted: I'd like your help with a special exhibit.
lines.Kindred: Your name is in the founders' book now.

requests.title: For the Display
requests.text: A Fine fish for the display case, please.

requests.title: Clay Samples
requests.text: Four clay samples for the archive.

requests.title: The Rare Exhibit
requests.text: A Rare fish. The centrepiece.

lines.Acquainted: Compost early, water late. That's the trick.
lines.Familiar: A salad from the nursery corner.
lines.Trusted: I'll show you how the regional seeds like their soil.
lines.Kindred: Half of this garden is yours now.
lines.mystery: I'll put it in the compost. Lovingly.

requests.title: Seedling Help
requests.text: Plant five plots. The soil is ready.

requests.title: Carrot Count
requests.text: Four carrots for the nursery.

requests.title: A Salad Bowl
requests.text: A salad, please. Fresh as you like.

requests.title: Gardener's Show
requests.text: Six tomatoes for the show bench.

lines.Stranger: FRESH BREAD! Oh — hello, didn't see you there.
lines.Acquainted: Weekend market's the best. You'll see.
lines.Familiar: Took this off the stove for you. Eat while it's hot!
lines.Trusted: Big orders this weekend. I need a partner.

requests.title: Potatoes, Please
requests.text: Six potatoes for the bread ovens.

requests.title: Stew for the Stall
requests.text: A stew for the market crowd.

requests.title: The Big Basket
requests.text: Eight crops, any kind. Market day is coming.

requests.title: Weekend Market
requests.text: Two stews. The whole square will be here.

profile.name: Farmer
profile._city: The P0 home city every player shares (SGODOT-270: one data change moves the whole server; the client reads it through P0City). city_short = the chip's short form when the full name does not fit (q(106): SF); region = map region and city-data id; timezone = the day's 04:00 rollover; the beginner pond is fishing.places' beginner one.
profile._farm_at: The homestead's map point (Noe Valley, 0.77 km from Fern Pond; 苏烈's plan on SGODOT-270): map markers send a fish request to the beginner pond, else the nearest pond to it (SGODOT-232, q(48)).

gather._note: SGODOT-231 §13.2 gathering spots: 0 Energy, one tap, each spot 8 h after it was gathered (ready at start). The first yield is the spot's material and goes to Farm Storage (+1 with Gather Gloves); worms go to the bag, any that do not fit go to storage (q(44)); seasonings (Rock Salt, Wild Herb) go to the bag and are not stored on coming home until the Spice Rack at Homestead Lv2, which puts them away (q(46)). P0 has no Old Tree (hardwood is P1, q(44)).

mine._note: SGODOT-231 §13.3 / LOCK-21, floors 1–2: 2 Energy the first time a run reaches a floor, 2 per rock, ≤ 2 runs a player day, a new run needs floor 2 cleared, 04:00 ends an unfinished run. Each rock: Stone by the pickaxe, plus one weighted extra drop derived from the run, floor and rock. Floor 2 quartz (15) is folded into Rock Salt for P0 (copper 30 / salt 35 / none 35; user, knob A, q(47)); P1 restores quartz. Fee-paying entrances (a new run, an unpaid floor) refuse when the floor's worst case doesn't fit (q(48)).

workbench._note: SGODOT-231 §13.4, P0 tabs Tools / Supplies only (q(31)). Costs come from Farm Storage first, then the bag. Supplies go to the bag (no room → not crafted, q(44)); the Copper Pickaxe goes to Gear (Equip there); Gather Gloves work at once. Compost needs Farming Lv3 like the stall (q(44)).
